path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article III. Names›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-43. Reservation of name
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article III. Names › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-43. Reservation of name
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-43. Reservation of name (2023)
content:
(a) The exclusive right to use a name permitted to be used by an association under
      this act may be reserved by an individual intending to incorporate an association,
      by an association intending to change its name, or by a Federal savings and loan association
      intending to convert into a State association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article IV. Offices›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article IV. Offices › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department (2023)
content:
(a) Upon receipt of an application for approval of a branch which satisfies the requirements
      of this act and the payment of all fees, and after such further notice as the department
      may require, the department shall conduct such investigation as it may deem necessary
      and in its discretion may hold hearings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors (2023)
content: (a) The business and affairs of an association shall be managed by a board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors (2023)
content: (a) The bylaws shall fix the number of directors at not less than five.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors (2023)
content:
(a) Each director shall hold office for the term for which he is elected and until
      his successor shall have been duly elected and qualified.  Directors shall be elected by the members for a term of one year except as otherwise
      provided in this article or in the articles or the bylaws.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers (2023)
content:
(a) An association shall have a president, a secretary and a treasurer and such other
      officers, including a conveyancer, as it may authorize.  The bylaws may provide that the same individual may hold two offices except that
      the president shall not hold any other office.  The president shall be a member of the board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-74. Department review of additions of any director or senior executive officer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-74. Department review of additions of any director or senior executive officer (2023)
content:
(a) An insured association or a Pennsylvania thrift institution holding company shall
      notify the department of the proposed addition of any individual as a senior executive
      officer of such institution or holding company at least thirty days before such addition
      or employment becomes effective, if the insured association or the Pennsylvania thrift
      institution holding company:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-64. Method of action by board of directors, executive or other committee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-64. Method of action by board of directors, executive or other committee
