title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-221. Examinations and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-221. Examinations and reports (2023)
content:
(a) The department shall examine all associations at least once every two calendar
      years and may examine any association more frequently and at any time it deems such
      action necessary or desirable for protection of members or creditors.  The examination shall include a review of the accounts, records and affairs of the
      association, its compliance with law and such other matters as the department may
      determine.  For this purpose the department may examine a person which is performing services
      for an association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XIII. Foreign and Federal Associations›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-211. Foreign corporations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XIII. Foreign and Federal Associations › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-211. Foreign corporations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-211. Foreign corporations (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in section 114,1foreign corporations shall not transact the business of an association within this
      Commonwealth, nor maintain an office within this Commonwealth for the purpose of transacting
      such business.  It shall be unlawful for any person to engage in the business of soliciting or receiving
      within this Commonwealth subscriptions to the shares or savings accounts of such corporations
      or payments therefor, or of granting loans within this Commonwealth on behalf of such
      corporations, or of soliciting applications therefor, or of receiving within this
      Commonwealth on behalf of such corporations, interest, premiums, fees or payments
      of any kind or of transacting business in any manner within this Commonwealth on behalf
      of such corporation.  Nothing in this section shall prohibit a bona fide mortgage or loan subsidiary of
      a foreign association from conducting its business in this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-236. Failure to keep proper accounts (2023)
content:
Any director, officer or employe of an association who knowingly violates the provisions
   of section 110 of this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XIV. Provisions Applicable to Department of Banking›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-222. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XIV. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-222. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this section a savings association or
      any director, officer, employe or attorney thereof shall not grant or give to the
      Secretary of Banking, any official or employe of the department, any deputy or any
      employe of the Secretary of Banking as receiver, any sum of money or any property
      as a gift, loan or otherwise, directly or indirectly--subject to the penalty provisions
      of this act.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-235. Dealings between an association and its directors, officers, employes and attorneys
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-235. Dealings between an association and its directors, officers, employes and attorneys (2023)
content:
Any officer, director, attorney or employe of an association who knowingly violates
   the provisions of either subsection (a)(2) or subsection (a)(3) of section 5101shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof, be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year, or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars
   ($1,000), or both.  He shall also be subject to a further fine equal to any profit which he shall have
   made upon the transaction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-1. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known, and may be cited, as the “Savings Association Code of 1967.”

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XVI. Effective Date and Repealers › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-254. Transition provisions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-254. Transition provisions (2023)
content:
(a) Transactions and proceedings commenced under or pursuant to statutes repealed
      by this act shall be terminated, completed or enforced pursuant to the provisions
      of such statutes which for such purpose shall remain in full force and effect as to
      such transactions and proceedings.

content: In the interpretation and construction of this act:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-5. Emergency powers (2023)
content:
In the event a nuclear attack or other disaster results in the declaration of an emergency
   an association may during the continuance of such emergency, without regard to any
   restriction or limitation of this act, take any action to preserve the assets of the
   association and to continue or resume its business, including any action to obtain
   the benefit of, or participate in, emergency action authorized by the Federal government.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-7. Advertisement (2023)
content:
(a) Every advertisement required by this act shall be published, except as otherwise
      provided in this act, once in a newspaper of general circulation and once in a legal
      newspaper.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-6. Certificates and certified copies of documents to be received in evidence (2023)
content:
All certificates issued by the Department of Banking and by the Department of State
   and all copies of articles, papers and other documents filed in either department
   and certified by the Secretary of the Department of Banking or by the Secretary of
   the Commonwealth shall be taken and received by all courts, public offices, and official
   bodies as prima facie evidence of the facts therein stated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-8. Notices (2023)
content:
(a) Written notice required to be given to any person under the provisions of this
      act or under the articles or bylaws of an association may be given to such person,
      either personally or by sending a copy thereof through the mail, or by telegram, charges
      prepaid, to his address appearing on the books of the association, or supplied by
      him to the association for the purpose of notice.  If the notice is sent by mail or by telegraph, it shall be deemed to have been given
      to the person entitled thereto when deposited in the United States mail or with a
      telegraph office for transmission to such person.  If such notice is of a meeting, it shall specify the place, date and hour of the
      meeting, and, in the case of a special meeting of members, the general nature of the
      business to be transacted.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-237. Repledging of collateral
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-237. Repledging of collateral
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-237. Repledging of collateral (2023)
content:
Any officer, director or employe of an association who knowingly violates section
   112 of this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-12. Repledging of collateral (2023)
content: (a) An association shall not repledge any property held by it in pledge or as collateral.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-234. Acceptance of fee for procuring loan (2023)
content:
Any director, officer, attorney, or employe of an association who knowingly violates
   the provision of subsection (a)(1) of section 5101of this act shall be guilty of a misdemeanor, and shall, upon conviction thereof,
   be subject to a fine not exceeding a sum equal to three times the amount of the value
   of the property which he received as such fee, commission or gift.  In addition he shall be disqualified from acting as an officer, director, attorney,
   or employe of any association within this Commonwealth for a period of five years
   after the date of such conviction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-238. Prohibition of promoter's fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-238. Prohibition of promoter's fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-238. Prohibition of promoter's fees (2023)
content:
Any incorporator, officer, director or employe who knowingly violates section 202(a)
   of this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-13. Statutory amendment of existing charters (2023)
content:
The charters of all existing building and loan associations and savings and loan associations
   heretofore granted shall be deemed to be amended to the extent necessary to give effect
   to the provisions of this act and to conform thereto.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-239. Transacting business before certificate of authorization issued (2023)
content:
Any officer or director of an association who knowingly violates section 209(a) of
   this act1shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-10. Books, records and accounts of associations (2023)
content:
(a) An association may maintain its books of account on a cash, accrual, or modified
      accrual basis, as determined by the board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-16. Federal agency references (2023)
content:
(a) Any reference in this act to the Federal Home Loan Bank Board shall mean the Office
      of Thrift Supervision under section 3 of the Home Owners' Loan Act (48 Stat. 128,12 U.S.C. § 1462a).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XVI. Effective Date and Repealers›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-253. General repeal
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XVI. Effective Date and Repealers › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-253. General repeal

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-11. Retention of records and admissibility of copies in evidence (2023)
content:
(a) Every association shall preserve in such form and manner that they may be readily
      produced upon proper demand, all of its records of original or final entries for a
      period of seven years from the date of making the last entry thereon, except that
      coupons accompanying deposits in a club account, such as a Christmas club or a vacation
      club, need not be so retained for more than two years from the date of closing of
      such account.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XVI. Effective Date and Repealers›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-251. Effective date

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article I. General Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article I. General Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-9. Execution of instruments (2023)
content:
Without regard to any other form of execution provided in the bylaws, an instrument
   in writing, or any assignment or endorsement thereof, executed or entered into between
   an association and any person and signed by the president or vice-president and by
   the secretary or treasurer of the association, shall be held to have been properly
   executed by and in behalf of the association.  Except as otherwise required by statute, the affixation of the corporate seal shall
   not be necessary to the valid execution, assignment or endorsement by an association
   of any instrument in writing.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967›Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-240. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Chapter 51A. Savings Association Code of 1967 › Article XV. Penalties and Criminal Provisions › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-240. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-240. Relationship of savings associations and their personnel with officials and employes of the department (2023)
content:
Any director, officer, attorney or employe of an association, or the Secretary of
   Banking, or any employe, or any official of the department who knowingly violates
   the provisions of either subsection (a) or subsection (b) of section 14021shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall upon conviction thereof, be subject to
   imprisonment not exceeding one year or a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000),
   or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-21. Incorporators

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-21. Incorporators (2023)
content: (a) A savings association may be incorporated by three or more adults.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-25. Advertisement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-25. Advertisement

(a) The incorporators shall advertise their intention to deliver, or the delivery
      of, articles of incorporation with the department once in each newspaper in which
      such advertisement is required to be made and published in accordance with section
      107.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-26. Approval of proposed association by department

content:
The incorporators shall make an application to the department for approval of the

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-23. Articles of incorporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-23. Articles of incorporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-23. Articles of incorporation (2023)
content: (a) Articles of incorporation shall be signed and acknowledged by each of the incorporators.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-22. Prohibition of promoters' fees (2023)
content:
(a) A savings association shall not pay any fee, compensation or commission for the
      promotion or organization of an association or for any part of the money collected
      from members, except legal fees and other usual and ordinary expenses necessary for
      its organization.  Any incorporator, officer, director or employe paying or receiving any such fee,
      compensation or commission shall be subject to the penalty provisions of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-29. Certificate of authorization to do business (2023)
content:
(a) Until receipt of a certificate of authorization issued by the department an association
      shall not open savings accounts for its members, incur indebtedness or transact any
      business except such business as is incident to its organization or to the obtaining
      of subscriptions.  Any officer or director violating this prohibition shall be subject to the penalty
      provisions of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-27. Issuance of certificate of incorporation (2023)
content:
If all the taxes, fees and charges required by law shall have been paid and if the
   name of the proposed association continues to be reserved or is available on the records
   of the Department of State the receipt of the articles by the Department of State
   with the written approval of the department shall constitute filing of the articles
   with the Department of State as of the date and time of receipt or as of any later
   date and time specified by the department and the Department of State shall immediately
   issue to the incorporators a certificate of incorporation as of the date and time
   of filing with the approved articles attached thereto and shall make and retain a
   copy of such certificate and articles.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-30. Organization meetings
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-30. Organization meetings
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-30. Organization meetings (2023)
content:
(a) After the filing of the articles in the Department of State the first meeting
      of the members shall be held within this Commonwealth at the call of the incorporators,
      or the majority of them, for the purpose of adopting such bylaws as this act and the
      articles require to be adopted by the members, and for such other purposes as shall
      be stated in the notice of the meeting.  The incorporators, at the call of the meeting, shall give to each member at least
      five days' written notice of the time and place of the meeting.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article III. Names›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-43. Reservation of name

      this act may be reserved by an individual intending to incorporate an association,
      by an association intending to change its name, or by a Federal savings and loan association
      intending to convert into a State association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IV. Offices›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IV. Offices › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-54. Approval of branch by department (2023)
content:
(a) Upon receipt of an application for approval of a branch which satisfies the requirements
      of this act and the payment of all fees, and after such further notice as the department
      may require, the department shall conduct such investigation as it may deem necessary
      and in its discretion may hold hearings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article II. Incorporation and Organization›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article II. Incorporation and Organization › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-31. Adoption and contents of bylaws (2023)
content:
(a) The members shall have the power to make, alter, amend and repeal the bylaws of
      an association, but such authority may be expressly vested by the articles or by the
      bylaws in the board of directors (except as to bylaws fixing the qualification, classification,
      or terms of office of directors), subject to the power of the members to change such
      action.  Unless the articles or bylaws otherwise provide, the powers hereby conferred shall
      be exercised by a majority vote of the directors or by the majority vote of members
      of the association present in person or by proxy at any regular or special meeting.  No notice shall be required to members for any regular meeting where such bylaw
      changes are to be considered.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-61. Board of directors

content: (a) The business and affairs of an association shall be managed by a board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-63. Term of office of directors; vacancies; classification of directors (2023)
content:
(a) Each director shall hold office for the term for which he is elected and until
      his successor shall have been duly elected and qualified.  Directors shall be elected by the members for a term of one year except as otherwise
      provided in this article or in the articles or the bylaws.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IV. Offices›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-55. Branches acquired from the receiver of a closed association
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IV. Offices › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-55. Branches acquired from the receiver of a closed association
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-55. Branches acquired from the receiver of a closed association (2023)
content:
Any association whose principal place of business is located in Pennsylvania may maintain
   as a branch any office which it acquires from the secretary, or public body of the
   United States, as receiver, in conjunction with an assumption of deposit liabilities
   of a closed association whether in connection with a purchase of assets, through a
   merger or consolidation or otherwise, without regard to the location of the principal
   place of business of the acquiring association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-62. Number and qualifications of directors (2023)
content: (a) The bylaws shall fix the number of directors at not less than five.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article IV. Offices›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-53. Authorization of new branches
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article IV. Offices › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-53. Authorization of new branches
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-53. Authorization of new branches (2023)
content:
(a) Upon a merger, consolidation or conversion of a Federal savings and loan association
      into a State association the resulting association may with the prior written approval
      of the department maintain as branches, in addition to its principal place of business,
      every office which was maintained prior to the merger or consolidation by the parties
      thereto or prior to the conversion by the Federal savings and loan association and
      which is located within Pennsylvania.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-65. Communications from Department of Banking
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-65. Communications from Department of Banking

content:
Every official communication directed by the department to an association, or to any
   officer thereof, shall be transmitted by the officer receiving it to the board of
   directors at the next meeting of such board, and shall be duly noted in the minutes
   of such meeting.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-68. Bonds (2023)
content:
Each officer and employe and any director who is authorized to handle money or negotiable
   assets on behalf of the association shall be bonded and the association may pay the
   cost of such bond.  The form, amount and surety of such bonds shall be such as is approved by the board
   of directors, but the department may require an additional amount or new or additional
   surety.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-67. Officers (2023)
content:
(a) An association shall have a president, a secretary and a treasurer and such other
      officers, including a conveyancer, as it may authorize.  The bylaws may provide that the same individual may hold two offices except that
      the president shall not hold any other office.  The president shall be a member of the board of directors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-82. Notice of meetings of members (2023)
content:
(a) If the time and place of a regular meeting of the members are stated in the bylaws,
      it shall be sufficient, in addition to any other notice, if any, required by the bylaws,
      to post a notice at the place of business of the association during the month immediately
      preceding the date of such meeting.  Written notice of each special meeting of members and of each regular meeting, the
      time and place of which are not stated in the bylaws, shall be given to each member
      of record entitled to vote at the meeting at least five days prior to the date thereof,
      unless a longer period of notice is required by the articles, bylaws, or other provisions
      of this act.  The notice required by this section shall specify the place, day and hour of the
      meeting, and, in the case of a special meeting, the general nature of the business
      to be transacted.  Notice of an adjourned meeting and of the business to be transacted at such meeting
      may be given by announcement at the meeting at which the adjournment is taken unless
      otherwise provided in the articles or bylaws.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-81. Meetings of members (2023)
content:
(a) Meetings of the members of an association shall be held at such place within the
      Commonwealth as shall be fixed by the bylaws or by the board of directors pursuant
      to the bylaws, or if none is so fixed, at the principal place of business of the association.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-86. Voting by joint holders of savings accounts and by joint mortgagors (2023)
content:
(a) Voting rights which are held jointly or as tenants in common by two or more persons,
      as fiduciaries or otherwise, shall be deemed to be represented for the purpose of
      determining a quorum if one or more such persons are present in person or by proxy.  Except as provided in subsection (b) of this section, the vote shall be the vote
      cast by such persons or a majority of such persons but if such persons are equally
      divided upon the manner of voting, the voting rights held by them shall be divided
      equally among such persons, without prejudice to the rights of such joint owners or
      the beneficial owners thereof among themselves.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-85. Voting by fiduciaries and pledgors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-85. Voting by fiduciaries and pledgors

(a) Savings accounts standing in the name of a fiduciary may be voted either in person
      or by proxy of the fiduciary.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article VI. Members›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article VI. Members › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-83. Quorum and action by members (2023)

      of business unless a quorum is present.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking›Miscellaneous Laws›Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys›PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 7 P.S. Banks and Banking › Miscellaneous Laws › Article V. Directors, Officers, Employes and Attorneys › PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 7 P.S. § 6020-71. Audits and reports (2023)
content:
(a) Except as provided in subsection (c) of this section the board of directors of
      an association shall cause an annual audit to be made of the books, papers, securities
      and affairs of an association and the loans thereof and such other matters as the
      department may require and such audit shall be made by an independent public accountant
      satisfactory to the department.  The department may by regulation establish minimum standards for audits and reports
      under this subsection (a).
