path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A contract involving appropriation of money shall designate the item of appropriation
      on which it is founded, and the estimated amount of the expenditure which shall be
      charged against the item, and certified by the borough controller on the contract,
      before it shall take effect as a contract.  Payment required by the contract shall be made from the fund appropriated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1041. Auditors to meet yearly and audit accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1041. Auditors to meet yearly and audit accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1041. Auditors to meet yearly and audit accounts (2023)
content:
(a) First meeting.--The auditors of the borough shall meet on the first Tuesday of January of each year
      and shall organize by the election of a chair and a secretary.  If the first Tuesday is a legal holiday, the meeting and organization shall take
      place the following day.  Two auditors shall constitute a quorum.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1053. Compensation of auditors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1053. Compensation of auditors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1053. Compensation of auditors (2023)
content:
(a) General compensation.--Subject to the limitations set forth in subsection (b), each auditor shall receive
      $10 per hour for each hour or portion of an hour necessarily employed in the discharge
      of the auditor's duties, to be paid by the borough.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1055. Subpoenas, oath and perjury
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1055. Subpoenas, oath and perjury
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1055. Subpoenas, oath and perjury (2023)
content:
(a) Subpoenas.--A majority of the auditors of any borough shall have the power to issue subpoenas
      to obtain the attendance of the persons whose accounts they are required to adjust,
      their executors and administrators, and of any persons whom it may be necessary to
      examine as witnesses and to compel their attendance, and may also compel the production
      of all documents, including books, vouchers and papers relative to borough accounts.  If any person refuses or neglects to appear, to produce documents or to testify,
      the auditors shall petition the court of common pleas of the county to issue a subpoena
      to the person and to require the person to produce documents or to appear and to testify
      before the court.  The court shall issue the subpoena if it deems the documents or testimony relevant
      to the issue.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller (2023)
content:
The council shall fix the annual salary of the controller.  Any change in salary, compensation or emoluments of the elected office shall become
   effective at the beginning of the next term of the controller.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts (2023)
content:
The controller shall not permit any appropriation made by the council to be overdrawn.  If an appropriation is exhausted, the object of which is not complete, the controller
   shall immediately report the fact to the council and accompany the report with a statement
   of the money which has been drawn on the appropriation and the particular purpose
   for which it is drawn.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.2. Attorney to auditors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.2. Attorney to auditors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.2. Attorney to auditors (2023)
content:
The borough auditors may employ an attorney if deemed advisable by a majority of the
   auditors.  The auditors, with the agreement of council, shall determine the compensation to
   be paid to the attorney.  If the auditors and council cannot agree on the compensation, upon petition of the
   auditors, the court of common pleas shall establish the compensation for the attorney
   employed by the auditors.  The compensation for the attorney shall be paid out of the borough general fund.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter F. Tax Collector›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter F. Tax Collector › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in subsection (b), the tax collector shall be the collector
      of all State, county, borough, school, institution district and other taxes levied
      within the borough by the authorities empowered to levy taxes.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1058. Pay of witnesses
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1058. Pay of witnesses
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1058. Pay of witnesses (2023)
content:
Witnesses, other than officers of the borough, appearing before the auditors and individuals
   or officers serving subpoenas shall be paid, out of the borough treasury upon authorization
   signed by a majority of the auditors and orders drawn on the borough treasury, the
   same fees as are payable for rendering similar services in civil proceedings before
   a magisterial district judge.  The amount paid shall be made a part of the charge against any officer who shall
   be charged by the auditors with any balance, if the costs have been incurred in establishing
   the balance.  The costs collected from any officer shall be repaid into the borough treasury.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1065. Countersigned warrants
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1065. Countersigned warrants

   the person presenting the warrant shall, if the controller requires, produce evidence

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances (2023)
content:
The borough controller shall, as often as the controller may deem expedient or the
   council shall direct, suggest plans to the council for the management and improvement
   of the borough finances.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.4. Appeals from audit
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.4. Appeals from audit
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.4. Appeals from audit (2023)
content:
It shall be lawful for the borough, or any taxpayer of the borough on its behalf,
   or any person whose account is settled or audited, to appeal from the settlement or
   audit, as shown in the auditors report, to the court of common pleas of the county
   no later than 40 days from the date of the filing of the auditor's report with the
   clerk of common pleas.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059. Auditors to settle accounts where witnesses do not appear
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059. Auditors to settle accounts where witnesses do not appear
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059. Auditors to settle accounts where witnesses do not appear (2023)
content:
If any person in possession of documents relative to public accounts before auditors
   refuses to produce the same or if any officer whose accounts are to be settled and
   adjusted by the auditors refuses to appear or submit to examination as directed by
   this subchapter, the auditors or a majority of them may proceed, by the examination
   of witnesses and other evidence, to ascertain and settle, as near as may be, the amount
   of public money received by the officer and its application to public purposes or
   otherwise.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.1. Completion, filing and publication of auditor's report and financial statement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.1. Completion, filing and publication of auditor's report and financial statement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.1. Completion, filing and publication of auditor's report and financial statement (2023)
content:
(a) Report.--The auditors shall complete the annual audit, adjustment and settlement as soon as
      possible after the end of the fiscal year.  The auditors shall, within ten days after completing the annual audit, publish once,
      in at least one newspaper of general circulation, concise financial information prepared
      or approved by the auditors and consistent with the audited financial statements for
      total assets, total liabilities and total net position at the end of the fiscal year
      and total revenue, total expenses and changes in total net position for that fiscal
      year and a reference to a place within the borough where copies of the financial statements
      and accompanying audit report may be examined.  If the full financial statements and accompanying audit report are not published,
      copies shall be supplied to the publishing newspaper when the request for publication
      is submitted.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.5. Taxpayers appealing to enter bond
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.5. Taxpayers appealing to enter bond
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.5. Taxpayers appealing to enter bond (2023)
content:
No appeal by a taxpayer or officer may be allowed unless, within the time of taking
   the appeal, the appellant secures a bond in the sum of $1,000 with sufficient surety
   to prosecute the appeal and to pay all costs of appeal, in case, if the appellant
   is a taxpayer, the appellant fails to obtain a final decision more favorable to the
   borough than that awarded by the auditors or, in case, if the appellant is an accounting
   officer, the appellant fails to obtain a final decision more favorable to the officer
   than that awarded by the auditors.  Unless the bond is filed as provided in this section, the court of common pleas,
   upon application, shall set aside the appeal.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller (2023)
content:
The borough controller shall keep a regular set of books which shall be opened and
   keep as many accounts, under appropriate titles, as may be necessary to show separately
   and distinctly all the estates and property, real and personal, vested in the borough,
   all trusts in the care of the borough, all debts due and owing the borough, all receipts
   and expenditures of the various departments of the borough government and all appropriations
   made by council and the sums under the same, respectively.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.6. Procedure on appeals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.6. Procedure on appeals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.6. Procedure on appeals (2023)
content:
(a) Evidence and burden.--In any proceeding upon an appeal from a report of the auditors, the accounts of the
      office or officers or the person, corporation, association, organization, committee
      or commission in question may be investigated de novo, and the burden shall be upon
      each officer, person, corporation, association, organization, committee or commission
      whose accounts are involved in the appeal of establishing the person's right to credits
      claimed by the person, but the opposing party in the appeal may use any facts, figures
      or findings of the report of the auditors as prima facie evidence against any officer
      or other entity.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.7. Findings of fact and law, judgment and appeals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.7. Findings of fact and law, judgment and appeals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.7. Findings of fact and law, judgment and appeals (2023)
content:
After the hearing, the court shall file its findings of fact and law and enter judgment
   accordingly, and the judgment so entered may be enforced by the prevailing party by
   any appropriate proceeding.  Appeals from the court's ruling may be taken in accordance with law.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--This subchapter shall not become operative or effective in any borough not having
      a controller until the borough shall, by ordinance, accept this chapter.  If a borough accepts this subchapter, the court of common pleas, upon petition of
      council, shall appoint a controller to hold office until the first Monday of January
      following the next municipal election at which a controller shall be elected under
      this part.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1061. Oath and bond of controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1061. Oath and bond of controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1061. Oath and bond of controller (2023)
content:
The borough controller shall, before entering upon the duties of office, take the
   required oath or affirmation of office under53 Pa.C.S. § 1141(relating to form of oaths of office).  The controller shall give bond to the borough with a surety company to be approved
   by the council, in a sum as council may direct by ordinance, conditioned for the faithful
   discharge of the controller's duties.  The amount of the bond shall be sufficient to adequately protect the borough from
   any illegal or unfaithful action by the controller.  The cost of the bond shall be paid by the borough.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.11. General powers and duties of independent auditor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.11. General powers and duties of independent auditor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.11. General powers and duties of independent auditor (2023)
content:
(a) Powers and duties.--If an independent auditor is appointed under section 1005(7) (relating to powers of
      council), the independent auditor shall have the same powers and duties and be subject
      to the same penalties as the auditors under this chapter.  The independent auditor shall annually examine, audit and settle all accounts in
      which the borough is concerned.  The audit shall consist of an examination in accordance with generally accepted
      auditing standards and shall include tests of the accounting records and other auditing
      procedures as the independent auditor considers necessary in the circumstances.  The independent auditor shall make and publish the annual financial report in the
      same form and manner and at the same time as required in this part of the auditors
      of the borough.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1067. Amount of contracts to be charged against appropriations (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A contract involving appropriation of money shall designate the item of appropriation
      on which it is founded, and the estimated amount of the expenditure which shall be
      charged against the item, and certified by the borough controller on the contract,
      before it shall take effect as a contract.  Payment required by the contract shall be made from the fund appropriated.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.8. Attorney fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.8. Attorney fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.8. Attorney fees (2023)

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1065. Countersigned warrants
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1065. Countersigned warrants
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1065. Countersigned warrants (2023)
content:
The controller shall countersign all warrants upon the borough treasurer, with the
   form of the warrant to be prescribed by council, except that no warrant shall be countersigned
   unless there is money in the treasury to pay the warrant.  If a warrant on the treasurer shall be presented to the controller to be countersigned,
   the person presenting the warrant shall, if the controller requires, produce evidence
   that:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1070. Appeals from controller's report
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10. Powers and Duties of Elected Officials › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1070. Appeals from controller's report
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1070. Appeals from controller's report (2023)
content:
Appeals may be taken from the settlement and audit of the controller, as shown in
   the controller's report to the court of common pleas of the county, by the same persons
   in the same manner within the same time subject to the same conditions and procedure
   and with like effect in every respect as provided in this part in the cases of appeals
   from the settlement and audit of the auditors as shown in their report.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1063. General powers and duties of controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1063. General powers and duties of controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1063. General powers and duties of controller (2023)
content:
(a) General duties and powers.--The borough controller shall manage the fiscal affairs of the borough.  The controller shall examine, audit and settle all accounts in which the borough
      is concerned either as debtor or creditor if provision for the settlement is made
      by law.  If no provision or an insufficient provision has been made, the controller shall
      examine the accounts and report to the council the relevant facts and opinion on the
      accounts.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.9. Balances due to be entered as judgments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.9. Balances due to be entered as judgments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.9. Balances due to be entered as judgments (2023)
content:
A balance in a report of the auditors against an officer of the borough shall constitute
   a surcharge against the officer as fully as if expressly stated in the report to be
   a surcharge.  The amount of a balance and of any express surcharge shall, if no appeal is taken
   or after an appeal has been finally determined in favor of the borough, be entered
   by the prothonotary as a judgment against the officer.  The clerk of the court of common pleas shall certify the amount of every balance
   or surcharge contained in a report from which no appeal has been taken within the
   time provided under this chapter to the court of common pleas for entry by the prothonotary
   as a judgment.  Any taxpayer of the borough may enforce the collection of the balance or surcharge
   for the benefit of the borough, by action or execution, upon filing in the court of
   common pleas a bond, in the sum of $1,000 with one or more sureties, conditioned to
   indemnify the borough from all costs of the proceedings undertaken by the taxpayer,
   subject to all rights of appeal from the report of auditors granted by this part.  If a person has been or shall be surcharged for an illegal purchase and no fraud
   or collusion is shown and the surcharge is paid to the borough, the article purchased
   shall become the property of the person surcharged.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Auditors›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.10. Penalty for failure to comply with law
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Auditors › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.10. Penalty for failure to comply with law
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1059.10. Penalty for failure to comply with law (2023)
content: (a) Neglect.--An auditor neglecting or refusing to comply with this chapter commits a summary offense.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1062. Salary of controller (2023)
content:
The council shall fix the annual salary of the controller.  Any change in salary, compensation or emoluments of the elected office shall become
   effective at the beginning of the next term of the controller.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1068. Controller's recommendations on borough finances (2023)
content:
The borough controller shall, as often as the controller may deem expedient or the
   council shall direct, suggest plans to the council for the management and improvement
   of the borough finances.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1069. Books to be kept by controller (2023)
content:
The borough controller shall keep a regular set of books which shall be opened and
   keep as many accounts, under appropriate titles, as may be necessary to show separately
   and distinctly all the estates and property, real and personal, vested in the borough,
   all trusts in the care of the borough, all debts due and owing the borough, all receipts
   and expenditures of the various departments of the borough government and all appropriations
   made by council and the sums under the same, respectively.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter F. Tax Collector›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter F. Tax Collector › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1086. Powers and duties of tax collector (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in subsection (b), the tax collector shall be the collector
      of all State, county, borough, school, institution district and other taxes levied
      within the borough by the authorities empowered to levy taxes.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1070. Appeals from controller's report

Appeals may be taken from the settlement and audit of the controller, as shown in
   the controller's report to the court of common pleas of the county, by the same persons
   in the same manner within the same time subject to the same conditions and procedure
   and with like effect in every respect as provided in this part in the cases of appeals
   from the settlement and audit of the auditors as shown in their report.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1066. Prevention of appropriation overdrafts (2023)
content:
The controller shall not permit any appropriation made by the council to be overdrawn.  If an appropriation is exhausted, the object of which is not complete, the controller
   shall immediately report the fact to the council and accompany the report with a statement
   of the money which has been drawn on the appropriation and the particular purpose
   for which it is drawn.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Controller›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Controller › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1071. Acceptance by ordinance (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--This subchapter shall not become operative or effective in any borough not having
      a controller until the borough shall, by ordinance, accept this chapter.  If a borough accepts this subchapter, the court of common pleas, upon petition of
      council, shall appoint a controller to hold office until the first Monday of January
      following the next municipal election at which a controller shall be elected under
      this part.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A01. Eligibility of mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A01. Eligibility of mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A01. Eligibility of mayor (2023)
content:
No mayor may hold any other borough office or appointment during the term for which
   the mayor is elected, except as is permitted under section 1104 (relating to appointments
   and incompatible offices).  The mayor shall be eligible to succeed himself.  The mayor shall not be a member of council, nor shall the mayor preside over or
   vote at any meeting of council, except as provided in section 1003 (relating to when
   the mayor may preside over council and vote, attendance of mayor at council meetings
   and breaking tie votes).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A02. Incompatible offices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A02. Incompatible offices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A02. Incompatible offices (2023)
content:
No member of Congress or any person holding any office or appointment of profit or
   trust under the Federal Government or any person holding the office of magisterial
   district judge may at the same time be capable of holding the office of mayor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A06. General powers of mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A06. General powers of mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A06. General powers of mayor (2023)
content: (a) Oaths and affirmations.--The mayor may administer oaths and affirmations in matters pertaining to borough affairs.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts (2023)
content:
All officers and employees appointed by a council shall, if directed, render their
   accounts to the council for settlement.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1104. Appointments and incompatible offices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1104. Appointments and incompatible offices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1104. Appointments and incompatible offices (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Unless there is incompatibility in fact, an elective or appointive officer of the
      borough shall be eligible to serve on any board, commission, bureau or other agency
      created by or for the borough or any borough office created or authorized by statute
      and may accept appointments under the statute.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A07. Duties of mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A07. Duties of mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A07. Duties of mayor (2023)
content: The mayor shall have the following duties:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A03. Oath of mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A03. Oath of mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A03. Oath of mayor (2023)
content:
The mayor, before exercising the duties of office, shall take and subscribe an oath
   or affirmation of office under53 Pa.C.S. § 1141(relating to form of oaths of office).  The oath or affirmation may be taken before a judge or magisterial district judge
   of the county or a notary public and shall be filed with the borough secretary and
   be preserved among the records of the borough for a period of six years.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A05. Salaried mayor not to receive certain fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A05. Salaried mayor not to receive certain fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A05. Salaried mayor not to receive certain fees (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as provided in subsection (b), any salary paid under an ordinance shall be
      in lieu of all costs and fees allowed by a mayor.  Costs and fees shall be collected by the mayor and deposited into the borough treasury.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter B. Treasurer›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1106. Bond and duties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter B. Treasurer › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1106. Bond and duties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1106. Bond and duties (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The borough treasurer shall, before entering upon the duties of office, give bond
      in an amount determined by council, conditioned for the faithful performance of the
      treasurer's duties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A04. Salary of mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A04. Salary of mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A04. Salary of mayor (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The salary of the mayor shall be established by ordinance and shall not exceed the
      following:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter B. Treasurer›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter B. Treasurer › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer (2023)
content:
A council may, by resolution, appoint an assistant treasurer who may not be a member
   of the council.  Council may appoint the assistant treasurer as the assistant secretary if the assistant
   treasurer is not a member of council.  The assistant treasurer shall assist the treasurer in the performance of the treasurer's
   duties and, in case of absence or disability of the treasurer, shall perform the duties
   and may exercise the powers of the treasurer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds (2023)
content:
If an appointed officer or employee of a borough is required by law or action of council
   to give bond for the faithful performance of the officer's or employee's duties, the
   borough may pay the premium on the bond.  All bonds required to be given by borough officials or employees shall be with a
   surety company authorized by law to act as surety.  The borough shall pay a proportionate share of the cost of the bond of an appointed
   tax collector in the same ratio as provided in section 804 (relating to term and bonds)
   for elected tax collectors.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1101. Compensation, hours and days of work and outside employment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1101. Compensation, hours and days of work and outside employment (2023)
content:
Appointed officers and employees of the borough shall receive compensation for their
   services as the council shall prescribe.  Council may also establish the hours and days of work and may restrict the outside
   employment of borough employees or any class or category of employment.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 10A. Mayor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A08. President or vice president of council to act as mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 10A. Mayor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A08. President or vice president of council to act as mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 10A08. President or vice president of council to act as mayor (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If the mayor is absent or incapacitated or there is a vacancy in the office, the duties
      of the office shall be discharged by the president of council or, in the absence or
      incapacity of the president of council or if there is a vacancy in the office, by
      the vice president of council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A borough may provide, by ordinance, to appointees and employees of not less than
      ten years of satisfactory service and who are not less than 60 years of age upon termination
      of active employment with the borough, a proportion of the compensation last paid
      to them but not in excess of 50% of the compensation, including benefits received
      under the Social Security Act (49 Stat. 620,42 U.S.C. § 301 et seq.), if any, as fixed in the ordinance or amendment of the ordinance.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1124. Suspension by mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1124. Suspension by mayor (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--In addition to the powers of council to suspend police officers, the mayor may, for
      cause and without pay, suspend any police officers until the succeeding regular meeting
      of the council at which time or later the council may, subject to Subchapter J (relating
      to civil service for police and fire apparatus operators),1if they are in effect at the time, suspend, discharge, reduce in rank or reinstate
      with pay the police officers.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1111. Duties

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1111. Duties (2023)
content:
(a) Attendance at meetings and maintenance of minutes.--The secretary shall attend all meetings of the council and shall maintain full minutes
      of its proceedings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter C. Secretary › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary (2023)
content:
A council may, by resolution, appoint an assistant secretary.  The assistant secretary shall assist the secretary in the performance of the secretary's
   duties and, in case of absence or disability of the secretary, perform the duties
   and may exercise the powers of the secretary.  The assistant secretary may be appointed from the membership of the council but
   shall not be any other officer of the council.  Council may appoint the assistant secretary as the assistant treasurer if the assistant
   secretary is not a member of council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter C. Secretary › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection (2023)
content:
The fiscal records and documents and the minute book and other records and documents
   of every borough shall be open in accordance with the act of February 14, 2008 (P.L.
   6, No. 3),1known as the Right-to-Know Law.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1123.1. Mayor's powers concerning police

      force.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1118. Assistant solicitor (2023)
content:
A council may, by resolution, appoint an assistant solicitor to assist the solicitor
   in the performance of the solicitor's duties and, in the absence or disability of
   the solicitor, to perform the duties and exercise the powers of the solicitor.

content:
Borough police officers shall wear a shield or badge with the word “Police” when on
   duty.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter E. Police›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1122. Police serving under cooperative agreement or contract
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1122. Police serving under cooperative agreement or contract
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1122. Police serving under cooperative agreement or contract (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If a borough enters into a cooperative agreement or contract with any municipal corporation,
      regional police force or other governmental entity created by two or more municipal
      corporations under 53 Pa.C.S. Ch. 23 Subch. A (relating to intergovernmental cooperation) for the furnishing or receiving of police
      protection as authorized by section 1202(24) (relating to specific powers), the police
      force of the municipal corporation, regional police force or other governmental entity
      furnishing the police protection shall be appointed and accepted as the police force
      of the borough receiving the police service by resolution of the council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter D. Solicitor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter D. Solicitor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters (2023)
content:
The legal matters of the borough shall be under the control of the borough solicitor.  No department or officer of the borough, except as otherwise provided by law, shall
   employ an additional counsel without the assent or ratification of the council.  The borough solicitor must be licensed to practice law in this Commonwealth and
   may be one person or a law firm, partnership, association or professional corporation.  The borough solicitor serves at the pleasure of council.  In the absence of the solicitor, the law firm of which the solicitor is a member
   or associate may perform any of the duties or functions of the solicitor.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1131. Police pension fund (2023)
content:
(a) Authorization to establish.--If a police force of less than three full-time members is being maintained, the borough
      may, unless there is a private organization or association constituting and managing
      an existing pension fund for the members of the police force in the borough, by ordinance,
      establish a police pension fund into which each member of the police force shall pay
      an equal and proportionate monthly charge to be withheld from the pay of the member.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter G. Manager › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1143. Other offices not incompatible
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1143. Other offices not incompatible (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The offices of borough manager, street commissioner, secretary, treasurer and chief
      of police shall not be incompatible, and any two or more or all of the offices may
      be held by one person.  Neither the mayor nor any member of the council shall be eligible to hold the office
      of borough manager.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1132. Private police pension funds and optional transfers (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If there is a private organization or association constituting and managing an existing
      pension fund for the members of the police force in any borough, the borough shall
      establish a police pension for the purpose of paying pensions to the members of its
      police force if the membership of the organization or association by a two-thirds
      vote elects to transfer its funds with all its assets and liabilities into a borough
      pension fund as required to be established by this part.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1141. Borough manager created by ordinance and election (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The council of a borough may, at its discretion at any time, create by ordinance the
      office of borough manager and may, in like manner, abolish the office. While the office exists, the council shall, from time to time, and if there is a vacancy,
      elect, by a vote of a majority of all the members, one individual, partnership, limited
      partnership, association or professional corporation as the borough manager.

      shall elect one of its members as the chair and one as the secretary.  Thereafter, the commission shall meet and organize within 30 days of the first Monday

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1177. Minutes and records
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1177. Minutes and records
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1177. Minutes and records (2023)
content:
The commission shall maintain minutes of its proceedings and records of examinations
   and other official actions.  All recommendations of applicants for appointment received by the commission shall
   be kept and preserved for a period of five years, and all records and all written
   causes of removal filed with the commission, except as otherwise provided in section
   1191 (relating to hearings on dismissals and reductions), shall be open to public
   inspection and subject to reasonable regulation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1178. Investigations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1178. Investigations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1178. Investigations (2023)
content:
The commission may conduct investigations concerning all matters touching the administration
   and enforcement of this subchapter and rules and regulations adopted under this subchapter.  The chair of the commission may administer oaths and affirmations in connection
   with the investigations.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1180. Annual report

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1180. Annual report (2023)
content:
The commission shall make an annual report to the council containing a brief summary
   of its work during the year which shall be available for public inspection.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1179. Subpoenas
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1179. Subpoenas
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1179. Subpoenas (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The commission may issue subpoenas over the signature of the chair to require the
      attendance of witnesses and the production of records and papers pertaining to any
      investigation or inquiry.  The fees of witnesses for attendance and travel shall be the same as for witnesses
      appearing in the courts and shall be paid from appropriations for the incidental expenses
      of the commission.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1176. Rules and regulations

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1176. Rules and regulations (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The commission may prescribe, amend and enforce rules and regulations for carrying
      into effect this subchapter and shall be governed by the rules and regulations.  Before the effective date of the rules and regulations or amendments to them, they
      shall be first approved by council.  If the rules and regulations or amendments have been approved, they shall not be
      annulled, amended or added to without the approval of council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1185. Age and residency of applicants
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1185. Age and residency of applicants
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1185. Age and residency of applicants (2023)
content:
No person shall be eligible to apply for examination unless the person is at least
   18 years of age at the date of application.  An applicant need not be a resident of the borough.  The council of the borough may authorize the commission, by rule or regulation,
   to require police officers and paid fire apparatus operators to become residents of
   the borough after appointment to the positions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1101. Compensation, hours and days of work and outside employment
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1101. Compensation, hours and days of work and outside employment
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1101. Compensation, hours and days of work and outside employment (2023)
content:
Appointed officers and employees of the borough shall receive compensation for their
   services as the council shall prescribe.  Council may also establish the hours and days of work and may restrict the outside
   employment of borough employees or any class or category of employment.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1102. Accounts (2023)
content:
All officers and employees appointed by a council shall, if directed, render their
   accounts to the council for settlement.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1104. Appointments and incompatible offices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1104. Appointments and incompatible offices (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Unless there is incompatibility in fact, an elective or appointive officer of the
      borough shall be eligible to serve on any board, commission, bureau or other agency
      created by or for the borough or any borough office created or authorized by statute
      and may accept appointments under the statute.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1103. Bonds (2023)
content:
If an appointed officer or employee of a borough is required by law or action of council
   to give bond for the faithful performance of the officer's or employee's duties, the
   borough may pay the premium on the bond.  All bonds required to be given by borough officials or employees shall be with a
   surety company authorized by law to act as surety.  The borough shall pay a proportionate share of the cost of the bond of an appointed
   tax collector in the same ratio as provided in section 804 (relating to term and bonds)
   for elected tax collectors.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1187. Provisional appointments
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1187. Provisional appointments
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1187. Provisional appointments (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If there are urgent reasons for the filling of a vacancy in a position in the police
      force and there are no names on the eligibility list for the appointment, the council
      may nominate a person to the commission for noncompetitive examination, and, if the
      nominee shall be certified by the commission as qualified after noncompetitive examination,
      the nominee may be appointed provisionally to fill the vacancy.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1105. Compensation of certain employees (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A borough may provide, by ordinance, to appointees and employees of not less than
      ten years of satisfactory service and who are not less than 60 years of age upon termination
      of active employment with the borough, a proportion of the compensation last paid
      to them but not in excess of 50% of the compensation, including benefits received
      under the Social Security Act (49 Stat. 620,42 U.S.C. § 301 et seq.), if any, as fixed in the ordinance or amendment of the ordinance.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter B. Treasurer › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1106. Bond and duties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1106. Bond and duties (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The borough treasurer shall, before entering upon the duties of office, give bond
      in an amount determined by council, conditioned for the faithful performance of the
      treasurer's duties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter B. Treasurer›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter B. Treasurer › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1107. Assistant treasurer (2023)
content:
A council may, by resolution, appoint an assistant treasurer who may not be a member
   of the council.  Council may appoint the assistant treasurer as the assistant secretary if the assistant
   treasurer is not a member of council.  The assistant treasurer shall assist the treasurer in the performance of the treasurer's
   duties and, in case of absence or disability of the treasurer, shall perform the duties
   and may exercise the powers of the treasurer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1188. Promotions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1188. Promotions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1188. Promotions (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A promotion shall be based on merit to be ascertained by an examination to be prescribed
      by the commission.  All questions relative to a promotion shall be practical in character and fairly
      test the merit and fitness of persons seeking promotion.

content:
(a) Required membership.--The following employees of municipal authorities shall be members of the borough retirement

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Secretary › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1112. Assistant secretary (2023)
content:
A council may, by resolution, appoint an assistant secretary.  The assistant secretary shall assist the secretary in the performance of the secretary's
   duties and, in case of absence or disability of the secretary, perform the duties
   and may exercise the powers of the secretary.  The assistant secretary may be appointed from the membership of the council but
   shall not be any other officer of the council.  Council may appoint the assistant secretary as the assistant treasurer if the assistant
   secretary is not a member of council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1111. Duties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Secretary › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1111. Duties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1111. Duties (2023)
content:
(a) Attendance at meetings and maintenance of minutes.--The secretary shall attend all meetings of the council and shall maintain full minutes
      of its proceedings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1192. Employees exempted
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1192. Employees exempted (2023)
content:
All appointments in the police or fire forces of boroughs, including the chief of
   police or equivalent official, prior to the creation of a commission, shall continue
   to hold their positions and shall not be required to take any examination under the
   provisions of this subchapter, except that which may be required for promotion.  This section shall not be construed to apply to persons employed temporarily in
   emergency cases.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter C. Secretary›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter C. Secretary › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1113. Records open to inspection (2023)
content:
The fiscal records and documents and the minute book and other records and documents
   of every borough shall be open in accordance with the act of February 14, 2008 (P.L.
   6, No. 3),1known as the Right-to-Know Law.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Solicitor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter D. Solicitor › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1116. Solicitor to have control of legal matters (2023)
content:
The legal matters of the borough shall be under the control of the borough solicitor.  No department or officer of the borough, except as otherwise provided by law, shall
   employ an additional counsel without the assent or ratification of the council.  The borough solicitor must be licensed to practice law in this Commonwealth and
   may be one person or a law firm, partnership, association or professional corporation.  The borough solicitor serves at the pleasure of council.  In the absence of the solicitor, the law firm of which the solicitor is a member
   or associate may perform any of the duties or functions of the solicitor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter D. Solicitor›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1118. Assistant solicitor

   the solicitor, to perform the duties and exercise the powers of the solicitor.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1186. Probationary period
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1186. Probationary period (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--An original appointment to a position in the police force or as a paid fire apparatus
      operator shall be for a probationary period of not less than six months and not more
      than one year, but during the probationary period an appointee may be dismissed only
      for a cause specified in section 1183 (relating to rejection of applicant and hearing)
      or because of incapacity for duty due to the use of alcohol or drugs.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1190. Removals

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1190. Removals (2023)
content:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter E. Police›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1124. Suspension by mayor
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1124. Suspension by mayor
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1124. Suspension by mayor (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--In addition to the powers of council to suspend police officers, the mayor may, for
      cause and without pay, suspend any police officers until the succeeding regular meeting
      of the council at which time or later the council may, subject to Subchapter J (relating
      to civil service for police and fire apparatus operators),1if they are in effect at the time, suspend, discharge, reduce in rank or reinstate
      with pay the police officers.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1193. Discrimination on account of political or religious affiliations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Discrimination on account of political or religious affiliations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1193. Discrimination on account of political or religious affiliations (2023)
content:
(a) Information.--No question in any form of application for examination or in any examination shall
      be so framed as to elicit information concerning the political or religious opinions
      or affiliations of any applicant nor shall inquiry be made concerning the opinions
      or affiliations, and all disclosures of opinions or affiliations shall be ignored.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter E. Police›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1123. Police badge
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1123. Police badge
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1123. Police badge (2023)
content:
Borough police officers shall wear a shield or badge with the word “Police” when on
   duty.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Subchapter E. Police›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1125. Compensation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Subchapter E. Police › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1125. Compensation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1125. Compensation (2023)
content:
Borough police and special police appointed by the mayor shall receive compensation
   as fixed by the council.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators›PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1194. Penalty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns › Part I. Boroughs › Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees › Subchapter J. Civil Service for Police and Fire Apparatus Operators › PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1194. Penalty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1194. Penalty (2023)
content:
A member of council who, by vote, appoints any person to the police force or as a
   fire apparatus operator contrary to the provisions of this subchapter, or a member
   of council or member of the commission who willfully refuses to comply with or conform
   to the provisions of this subchapter, commits a misdemeanor and, upon conviction,
   shall be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding $100 or to imprisonment not exceeding
   90 days, or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 8 Pa.C.S.A. Boroughs and Incorporated Towns›Part I. Boroughs›Chapter 11. Powers, Duties and Rights of Appointed Officers and Employees›Subchapter J. citation: PA Stat § PA ST 8 Pa.C.S.A. § 1191. Hearings on dismissals and reductions (2023)
content:
(a) Time of answer and hearing.--A person suspended, removed or reduced in rank may make written answers to any charges
      filed against the person not later than the day scheduled for the hearing.  The commission shall grant the person a hearing that shall be held within a period
      of ten days from the filing of written charges, unless continued by the commission
      for cause at the request of the council or the accused.  The failure of the commission to hold a hearing within ten days from the filing
      of the written charges shall not result in the dismissal of the charges filed.
