path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-1. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the “Temple University--Commonwealth Act.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Residency Status for Military Personnel and Dependents›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2509. Residency status for military personnel and their dependents; rate of tuition
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Residency Status for Military Personnel and Dependents › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2509. Residency status for military personnel and their dependents; rate of tuition
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2509. Residency status for military personnel and their dependents; rate of tuition (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The term “resident” or “residency,” or any other term or expression used to designate a Commonwealth resident student,
   when used to determine the rate of tuition to be charged students attending community
   colleges, public institutions of higher learning, State-related institutions, State-owned
   institutions and private institutions shall be construed to mean and include any veterans,
   their spouses and dependent children who do not currently reside in Pennsylvania.  The term shall also be construed to mean and include military personnel, their spouses
   and dependent children who are assigned to an active duty station in Pennsylvania
   and who reside in Pennsylvania and any civilian personnel, their spouses and dependent
   children employed at a Department of Defense facility who are transferred to Pennsylvania
   by the Department of Defense and who reside in Pennsylvania.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Pennsylvania Area College Center Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2501.12. Appropriations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Pennsylvania Area College Center Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2501.12. Appropriations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2501.12. Appropriations (2023)
content:
All moneys due from tuition, laboratory and library fees, shall be collected by each
   area and shall be paid to the Department of Public Instruction1for transmittal to the State Treasurer through the Department of Revenue.  All such moneys are hereby appropriated to the Department of Public Instruction
   for the payment of salaries, rent, equipment and other expenses of every description
   incurred in the operation and organization of college centers by the Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-3. Change of name
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-3. Change of name
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-3. Change of name (2023)
content:
The Charter of Temple University shall be amended by changing the name of Temple University
   to “Temple University--Of The Commonwealth System of Higher Education,” hereinafter
   referred to as “the University” and, as such, shall continue as a corporation for
   the same purposes as, and with all rights and privileges heretofore granted to, Temple
   University, unless hereinafter modified or changed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-5. Powers and duties of board of trustees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-5. Powers and duties of board of trustees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-5. Powers and duties of board of trustees (2023)
content:
The entire management, control and conduct of the instructional, administrative, and
   financial affairs of the university is hereby vested in the board of trustees.  The board may exercise all the powers and franchises of the university and make
   by-laws for their own government, as well as for the university.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-4. Board of trustees; composition; Commonwealth trustees; terms
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-4. Board of trustees; composition; Commonwealth trustees; terms
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-4. Board of trustees; composition; Commonwealth trustees; terms (2023)
content:
(a) The Board of Trustees of the University shall consist of thirty-six voting members,
      together with the Governor of the State, the Superintendent of the Department of Public
      Instruction,1and the Mayor of the City of Philadelphia, all of whom shall be members of the board
      of trustees, ex officio.  The elective and appointive members, except as hereinafter provided, shall serve
      for four year terms.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-6. Public support, tuition
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-6. Public support, tuition
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-6. Public support, tuition (2023)
content:
The university shall maintain such tuition and fee schedules for Pennsylvania resident
   and non-Pennsylvania resident full-time students as are set forth annually in the
   act of the General Assembly which makes appropriations to Temple University:  Provided,
   That the amounts appropriated by said act are sufficient for the maintenance of such
   schedules by the university:  And, provided further, That for any given year, in the
   event the amounts appropriated are not sufficient for the maintenance of said tuition
   and fee schedules, the university shall have the right to alter said schedules to
   the extent necessary to provide required income equal to the amount not provided by
   the appropriation act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-101. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-101. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-101. Short title (2023)
content:
This act shall be known and may by cited as the “Indiana University of Pennsylvania
   Act.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-103. Redesignation of the board of trustees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-103. Redesignation of the board of trustees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-103. Redesignation of the board of trustees (2023)
content:
The Board of Trustees of Indiana State College is hereby redesignated as the “Indiana
   University of Pennsylvania Board of Trustees.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-7. Capital improvements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-7. Capital improvements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-7. Capital improvements (2023)
content:
The benefits of all Commonwealth or Commonwealth authority programs for capital development
   and improvement shall be available to the university under terms and conditions comparable
   to those applicable to land grant institutions of higher learning and State colleges.  In accordance with legislative appropriations made as provided by law, the Commonwealth
   may, by agreement with the board of trustees, acquire lands, erect and equip buildings,
   and provide facilities for the use of the university.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-8. Appropriations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-8. Appropriations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-8. Appropriations (2023)
content:
(a) The sums appropriated by the Commonwealth shall be paid to the board of trustees
      only upon presentation by them of certified payrolls and vouchers showing expenditures
      in accordance with the appropriations.  The Auditor General shall draw a warrant upon the State Treasurer for payment of
      approved expenditures.  All expenditures made by the board of trustees in respect to such appropriations
      shall be subject to a post-audit by the Auditor General.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-10. Reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-10. Reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-10. Reports (2023)
content:
The President of the university shall each year, not later than the first day of October,
   make a report of all the activities of the university, instructional, administrative
   and financial, for the preceding scholastic and fiscal year, to the board of trustees,
   who shall transmit the same to the Governor and to the members of the General Assembly.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-12. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-12. Effective date

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Temple University--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-9. Issuance of bonds tax exempt within the Commonwealth
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Temple University--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-9. Issuance of bonds tax exempt within the Commonwealth
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-9. Issuance of bonds tax exempt within the Commonwealth (2023)
content:
(a) The board of trustees may provide for the issuance of bonds in the name of the
      university for any proper purpose in the same manner as heretofore.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-105. Powers and duties of board of trustees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-105. Powers and duties of board of trustees

content:
(a) The affairs of the university established under this act shall be administered

      by the State Board of Education provided for State universities, the board shall,
      for the purpose of operating and maintaining the university, have the power and its
      duty shall be to:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-104. Board of trustees, organization
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-104. Board of trustees, organization
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-104. Board of trustees, organization (2023)
content:
The board of trustees shall organize at such times each year as it shall determine
   and, subject to the approval of the Governor, elect a president.  The board shall also elect a treasurer, a business manager, a secretary and such
   officers as it shall determine.  A majority of the board shall constitute a quorum.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›University of Pittsburgh--Commonwealth Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-208. Capital improvements
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › University of Pittsburgh--Commonwealth Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-208. Capital improvements
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-208. Capital improvements (2023)
content:
The benefits of all Commonwealth or Commonwealth authority programs for capital development
   and improvement shall be available to the university under terms and conditions comparable
   to those applicable to land grant institutions of higher learning and State colleges.  In accordance with legislative appropriations made as provided by law, the Commonwealth
   may, by agreement with the board of trustees, acquire lands, erect and equip buildings,
   and provide facilities for the use of the university:  Provided, however, the university
   shall pay to the Department of Property and Supplies1the same aggregate rentals as that department shall pay to the General State Authority
   for any dormitory authorized under the provisions of the act of January 21, 1966 (P.L.
   1446).2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-107. Degrees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-107. Degrees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-107. Degrees (2023)
content:
The institution may grant the degrees of bachelor of arts, bachelor of science, and
   bachelor of fine arts for successful completion of prescribed undergraduate courses
   of study, and may grant the degrees of master of education, master of arts, master
   of science, doctor of education, and doctor of philosophy for successful completion
   of prescribed graduate courses of study.  In addition, the institution may grant other degrees when recommended by the board
   of trustees and approved by the State Board of Education.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-102. Redesignation of Indiana State College
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-102. Redesignation of Indiana State College
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-102. Redesignation of Indiana State College (2023)
content:
The name of Indiana State College, located and established at Indiana, Pennsylvania,
   is hereby changed to the “Indiana University of Pennsylvania.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-106. Officers of the university
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-106. Officers of the university
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-106. Officers of the university (2023)
content:
(a) The president shall be the chief executive and administrative officer of the university
      and shall perform all duties which the board of trustees may prescribe.  He shall have the right to attend all meetings of the board and to be heard on all
      matters before it, but shall have no right to vote on any matter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-109. Other state colleges
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-109. Other state colleges
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-109. Other state colleges (2023)
content:
All other State colleges may, with the approval of the State Board of Education, elect
   to become universities and be operated under the provisions of this act.  The board of trustees of any such State college may submit a plan to the State Board
   of Education, which shall include the proposed name of the State college, the degrees
   which it proposes to confer, the courses to be offered, the schools to be established
   and such other information as the State Board of Education may require.  Whenever the State Board of Education is satisfied that any such plan is in the
   best interest of higher education, and that the State college is adequately equipped
   and capable of implementing the plan it shall approve the plan and the State colleges
   shall thereafter be operated under the provisions of this act in so far as they are
   applicable.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 24 P.S. Education›Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries›Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act›PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-110. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 24 P.S. Education › Chapter 3. Colleges, Universities and Theological Seminaries › Indiana University of Pennsylvania Act › PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-110. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 24 P.S. § 2510-110. Effective date (2023)
content:
This act shall take effect immediately upon accreditation by the Middle States Association
   of Colleges and Secondary Schools.
